title: Slaynt as y corp
description: Ten short, simple stories about health and the body on the Isle of Man.

lessons.title: Çhingys ayns yn oie
lessons.summary: Emily wakes in the night with a fever; her mother Sarah takes her temperature, gives her water in a cup and stays with her until morning.
lessons.text:
Ta Emily Corkish 9 bleeaney d'eash. T'ee cummal ayns Doolish marish e moir, Sarah.

Ayns mean yn oie, ta Emily goll magh ass e shamyr. Ta'n thie dorraghey, as cha nel ee mie. Ta'n kione eck çheh, as ta'n sooill eck jiarg.

T'ee goll dys shamyr e moir. Ta'n dorrys foshlit. “Cha nel mee mie,” t'ee gra.

Ta Sarah cur y soilshey er. T'ee jeeaghyn er sooillyn Emily, as t'ee towse yn çhiassid eck. Ta'n çhiassid ard.

“Ta çhingys ort,” ta Sarah gra. “Cha nel oo goll dys y scoill jiu. Bee oo 'sy thie marym.”

Ta Sarah cur ushtey ayns cappan. “Gow yn cappan shoh,” t'ee gra. Ta Emily goaill yn ushtey veih'n chappan.

Ta Sarah goll marish Emily dys y shamyr eck. Ta Emily lhie sheese. Cha nel Sarah cur y soilshey er: ta'n shamyr dorraghey, agh ta'n dorrys foshlit, as ta soilshey beg çheet stiagh.

“Vel oo goll dy ve ayns shoh?” ta Emily gra.

“Ta,” ta Sarah gra. “Bee mee ayns shoh choud's ta çhingys ort. Bee mee ayns shoh choud's ta feme ayd orrym.”

Ta Sarah soie 'sy çhamyr. Lurg tammylt, ta sooillyn Emily dooint. Lurg tammylt elley, ta Sarah goaill fea neesht.

Ec y voghrey, ta Sarah towse yn çhiassid reesht. Ta'n çhiassid ny sloo nish. “Ta'n oie er ve liauyr,” ta Sarah gra, “agh t'ou ny share.”

Feyshtyn:
Row'n thie dorraghey ayns yn oie?
Va. Va'n thie dorraghey, as cha row Emily mie.
Row'n dorrys foshlit?
Va. Va'n dorrys foshlit.
Row çhiassid ard ec Emily?
Va. Va çhiassid ard eck, as va çhingys urree.
Ren Sarah cur ushtey ayns cappan?
Ren. Ren ee cur ushtey ayns cappan da Emily.
Row Sarah marish Emily choud's va çhingys urree?
Va. Va Sarah 'sy çhamyr maree rish yn oie.

lessons.title: Brishey 'sy phairk
lessons.summary: Harvey, a strong boy who loves soccer, falls in the wet park; the X-ray machine at the hospital shows a small break, and he will soon play again.
lessons.text:
Ta Harvey Leece 13 bleeaney d'eash. She guilley lajer eh, as s'mie lesh spoyrt. She sockyr yn spoyrt share lesh. Dagh Jesarn, t'eh cloie sockyr 'sy phairk ayns Rhumsaa marish guillyn elley.

Jiu, ta'n pairk fliugh. Ta Harvey roie dy tappee lesh y bluckan. Agh t'eh tuittym, as t'eh tuittym er e laue. Nish, ta Harvey heese er y thalloo.

Ta'n reireyder çheet dy tappee. “Fuirree heese,” t'eh gra. Ta guilley elley roie dys ayr Harvey, Logan.

Ta Logan goll lesh Harvey dys y thie-lheeys ayns Doolish. Ayns y thie-lheeys, ta greie er lheh oc. Ta'n greie shoh jeeaghyn er y corp sthie. Ta ben-lheihys jeeaghyn er laue Harvey lesh y ghreie.

“Ta brishey beg ayns y laue,” t'ee gra. “Agh cha nel y brishey mooar. Ta stayd y laue mie.”

“Vel lheeys ayd dou?” ta Harvey gra.

“Cha nel feme ort er lheeys,” ta'n ven-lheihys gra. “Ta feme ort er traa. She guilley lajer oo. Ta craueyn lajer ec guillyn aegey.”

T'ee cur stoo trome er y laue. “Ny cloie sockyr son shey shiaghtinyn,” t'ee gra.

“Shey shiaghtinyn!” ta Harvey gra. “She traa liauyr shen!”

“Ta'n stayd echey mie,” ta'n ven-lheihys gra rish Logan. “Bee eh cloie spoyrt reesht dy tappee.”

Lurg shey shiaghtinyn, ta Harvey ayns y phairk reesht. T'eh roie dy tappee, as t'eh cloie sockyr marish ny guillyn.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Harvey ny ghuilley lajer?
Ta. She guilley lajer eh, as s'mie lesh spoyrt.
Row'n pairk fliugh?
Va. Va'n pairk fliugh, as huitt Harvey.
Ren y ven-lheihys jeeaghyn er y laue lesh greie?
Ren. Ren ee jeeaghyn er y laue lesh greie er lheh.
Row brishey mooar ayns y laue?
Cha row. Va brishey beg ayn, as va'n stayd mie.
Row feme echey er lheeys?
Cha row. Va feme echey er traa.

lessons.title: Ladjyn 'sy cholleish
lessons.summary: Kieran studies medicine at a college in England; the Latin names of the body are hard, until his friend Tilly, a mathematician, shows him how to learn ten a day.
lessons.text:
Ta Kieran Collister 19 bleeaney d'eash. T'eh veih Ellan Vannin, agh nish t'eh ec colleish ayns Sostyn. T'eh ynsaghey lheeys ec y cholleish. She ynsagh liauyr eh: bee Kieran ec y cholleish rish queig bleeaney.

Ta monney lioaryn echey. Dagh oie, t'eh lhaih ny lioaryn shen. Agh ta Ladjyn ayns ny lioaryn. Ta ennym Ladjyn ec dagh nhee 'sy chorp, as cha nel Kieran toiggal monney Ladjyn.

Ta carrey echey ec y cholleish, Tilly. She maddaghteyr ee. T'ee gobbraghey lesh earrooyn. Ta Kieran loayrt rish Tilly.

“Cha nel mee toiggal ny focklyn shoh,” t'eh gra. “Ta ennym Ladjyn ec dagh nhee, as ta ram nheeghyn 'sy chorp!”

“Ta scansh vooar ec Ladjyn ayns lheeys,” ta Tilly gra. “Agh she maddaghteyr mee. Jeeagh er yn earroo. Ta mysh 600 focklyn ayn. My vees oo lhaih 10 focklyn dagh laa, bee oo toiggal ad ooilley ayns 60 laa. Cha nel shen monney.”

Ta Kieran jannoo myr dooyrt y maddaghteyr. Dagh laa, t'eh lhaih 10 focklyn Ladjyn. Dagh oie, t'eh gra ny focklyn reesht. Lurg mee, t'eh toiggal ny smoo.

Lurg 60 laa, ta Kieran toiggal dagh fockle. T'eh lhaih ny lioaryn as t'eh toiggal ad.

“Ta scansh vooar ec earrooyn neesht,” t'eh gra rish Tilly. “Va ynsagh vie ayd ec y cholleish!”

“Va,” ta Tilly gra. “As nish, vel oo goll dy ynsaghey dou yn ennym Ladjyn er y chree?”

Feyshtyn:
Vel Kieran ynsaghey lheeys ec colleish?
Ta. T'eh ynsaghey lheeys ec colleish ayns Sostyn.
Vel ennym Ladjyn ec dagh nhee 'sy chorp?
Ta. Ta ennym Ladjyn ec dagh nhee 'sy chorp.
Vel Tilly ny maddaghteyr?
Ta. T'ee gobbraghey lesh earrooyn.
Quoid dy focklyn ren Kieran lhaih dagh laa?
Ren eh lhaih 10 focklyn dagh laa.
Row Kieran toiggal dagh fockle lurg 60 laa?
Va. V'eh toiggal dagh fockle.

lessons.title: Yn kiaulleyder as y radio
lessons.summary: Grandfather Isaac, an old musician, can no longer hear the radio; his family notice, and a small hearing aid connected to the radio brings back his hearing and his humour.
lessons.text:
Ta Isaac Cowle 82 bleeaney d'eash. Tra v'eh aeg, v'eh ny chiaulleyder. V'eh cloie kiaull er feie'n ellan. Ta aittys mooar echey: s'mie lesh sleih e skeealyn aitt.

Dy cliaghtagh, ta Isaac soie ec oaie y thie dagh laa, as t'eh clashtyn rish y radio. Agh nish, ta'n radio feer ard. Ta'n vooinjer echey çheet dys y thie dagh mee, as t'ad fakin dy vel y radio ny smoo ard dagh keayrt.

“Vel oo clashtyn y radio, ayr?” ta Daisy gra. She Daisy inneen Isaac.

Cha nel Isaac gra veg.

Ta Daisy loayrt rish y vooinjer. “Cha nel ayr clashtyn dy mie,” t'ee gra. “Ta feme echey er greie.”

Ta Daisy goll lesh Isaac dys y thie-lheeys ayns Pheeil. Ayns shen, ta ben aeg cur greie beg ayns e chleaysh. Ta cochiangle eddyr y greie as y radio.

“Lesh y chochiangle shoh,” t'ee gra, “bee oo clashtyn y radio trooid y ghreie.”

“She red aitt eh,” ta Isaac gra. “Ta radio aym ayns my chione nish!”

Lurg y laa shen, t'eh soie ec oaie y thie reesht. T'eh clashtyn y radio, as cha nel y radio ard. T'eh clashtyn kiaull neesht. Ta'n clashtyn echey er çheet er ash.

Lurg mee, ta'n vooinjer çheet. Ta Isaac clashtyn dagh fockle. T'eh gra skeealyn aitt, as s'mie lesh y vooinjer ny skeealyn. Ta'n aittys echey er çheet er ash neesht.

“She ayr cliaghtagh eh reesht,” ta Daisy gra.

Feyshtyn:
Row Isaac ny chiaulleyder?
Va. V'eh cloie kiaull er feie'n ellan.
Row Isaac clashtyn y radio dy mie?
Cha row. Va'n radio feer ard.
Vel cochiangle eddyr y greie as y radio?
Ta. Ta cochiangle eddyr y greie as y radio.
Vel aittys ec Isaac?
Ta. T'eh gra skeealyn aitt.
Vel y clashtyn echey er çheet er ash?
Ta. T'eh clashtyn y radio as y kiaull.

lessons.title: Bee noa
lessons.summary: Lauren's doctor tells her to eat less meat and drink less beer; she compares her old and new food on paper, takes fruit and fish to work in a box, and is well three months later.
lessons.text:
Ta Lauren Lewin 45 bleeaney d'eash. T'ee gobbraghey ayns oik ayns Doolish. Hie ee dys y ven-lheihys, as dooyrt y ven-lheihys r'ee: “Ta monney feill as monney lhune ayns y bee ayd. Gow ny sloo feill, as ny sloo lhune.”

Ec y thie, ta Lauren jannoo cosoylaght. T'ee screeu er pabyr. Hoshiaght, t'ee screeu yn bee v'ee gee roish: feill dagh laa, as lhune dagh oie. Eisht, t'ee screeu yn bee noa: eeast, messyn as oohyn. She cosoylaght vie eh.

T'ee goll dys y margey. T'ee kionnaghey eeast, messyn, oohyn dhone as arran dhone. Ta'n arran dhone ny share na'n arran bane.

Dagh laa, ta Lauren cur bee ayns saagh beg son yn obbyr. Ta eeast ayns y saagh, as mess. Ec yn oik, t'ee roostey y mess. Ta'n roost buigh, as ta blass geyre er. Ta blass geyre ec paart jeh ny messyn, agh s'mie lhee y blass shen.

Ayns y touree, ta'n çhiassid ard. Ta Lauren cur rio ayns cappan ushtey. Ta'n rio lheie dy tappee. Tra ta'n rio lheie, t'ee cur rio elley 'sy chappan.

Lurg tree meeaghyn, ta Lauren goll dys y ven-lheihys reesht.

“T'ou jeeaghyn feer vie,” ta'n ven-lheihys gra. “Vel oo gee feill foast?”

“Ta, agh ny sloo,” ta Lauren gra. “As ta lhune aym dagh Jesarn ynrican.”

“Ta shen mie,” ta'n ven-lheihys gra. “She cosoylaght vooar eh rish y bee v'ayd roish.”

Feyshtyn:
Row monney feill ayns bee Lauren?
Va. Va monney feill as monney lhune ayns y bee eck.
Ren Lauren cosoylaght er pabyr?
Ren. Ren ee screeu y bee shenn as y bee noa.
Ren ee kionnaghey arran dhone?
Ren. Ren ee kionnaghey oohyn dhone as arran dhone.
Row eeast ayns y saagh?
Va. Va eeast as mess ayns y saagh.
Row blass geyre er y roost?
Va. Va blass geyre er.
Ren y rio lheie?
Ren. Ren y rio lheie dy tappee, son va'n çhiassid ard.

lessons.title: Er mullagh y clieau
lessons.summary: After a long illness Ryan is told to get out in the fresh air; he walks up a hill in the wind, past ducks and their chicks on a stream, and sees the whole island from the top.
lessons.text:
Ta Ryan Quaggin 50 bleeaney d'eash. Va çhingys trome er rish mee. Nish t'eh ny share, as ta'n ven-lheihys gra rish: “Ta feme ort er aer vie. Immee çheumooie dagh laa.”

Jiu, ta Ryan goll çheumooie. T'eh goll seose er slieau faggys da'n thie echey. Ta geay lajer ayn. Ta'n gheay goll trooid e folt.

Ec bun y clieau, ta stroo beg. Ta'n stroo goll dy tappee harrish ny claghyn. Er y stroo, ta laagh. Ta kiare ein marish y laagh. Ta ny ein beggey as buigh. Ta'n laagh goll roish, as ta ny ein goll ny yei.

Ta Ryan goll seose. Ta ushagyn erskyn y clieau. Ta ny h-ushagyn goll seose as sheese 'sy gheay. Ta ushag vooar erskyn y chronk, as cha nel ee gleashaghey e skianyn.

Lurg tammylt, ta Ryan er vullagh y clieau. Ta reayrt vie veih'n vullagh. T'eh fakin yn ellan ooilley: ny baljyn, ny magheryn as y vooir.

Ta creg vooar er y vullagh. Ta Ryan soie er oirr y chreg, agh cha nel eh goll ro faggys da'n oirr. Ta'n geay lajer.

“Ta'n reayrt shoh share na lheeys erbee,” t'eh gra.

T'eh goll sheese reesht. Ec y stroo, ta'n laagh as ny ein foast ayn. Ta Ryan skee, agh t'eh maynrey.

Feyshtyn:
Ren y ven-lheihys gra rish Ryan goll çheumooie?
Ren. Dooyrt ee dy row feme echey er aer vie.
Row geay lajer ayn?
Va. Va geay lajer ayn.
Quoid dy ein va marish y laagh?
Va kiare ein marish y laagh er y stroo.
Row ushagyn erskyn y clieau?
Va. Va ny h-ushagyn goll seose as sheese 'sy gheay.
Row reayrt vie veih'n vullagh?
Va. V'eh fakin yn ellan ooilley.

lessons.title: Bratteeyn 'sy thie-lheeys
lessons.summary: Lola came from abroad by train and ship seven years ago to work at the hospital in Douglas; on an international day the hospital hangs the flags of its staff's eight nations, and the newspaper writes about it.
lessons.text:
Ta Lola Romero 35 bleeaney d'eash. T'ee gobbraghey ayns y thie-lheeys ayns Doolish. T'ee veih çheer joarree. Shiaght bleeaney er dy henney, haink ee dys Ellan Vannin. Hie ee er y traen veih'n çheer eck dys Lerphoyll. Va'n traen feer tappee. Eisht, haink ee er y lhong veih Lerphoyll dys Doolish. Va'n lhong mooar as bane.

Ayns y thie-lheeys, ta sleih veih ymmodee ashoonyn gobbraghey. Ta hoght ashoonyn ayns y possan ec Lola: shiaght ashoonyn joarree, as Ellan Vannin. Ta dagh peiagh 'sy phossan loayrt Baarle, as ta paart jeu ynsaghey Gaelg.

Jiu, she laa eddyrashoonagh eh son sleih ta gobbraghey ayns thieyn-lheeys. Ta brattagh son dagh ashoon ec dorrys y thie-lheeys. Ta hoght bratteeyn ayn. Ta Lola jeeaghyn er y vrattagh eck. T'ee maynrey.

Ta peiagh veih'n phabyr-naight çheet. T'eh loayrt rish Lola. “Vel oo goll er ash dys y çheer ayd?” t'eh gra.

“Cha nel,” ta Lola gra. “She Ellan Vannin my hie nish. Ta my vooinjer joarree, agh ta mee cummal ayns shoh.”

Lurg daa laa, ta'n naight ayns y phabyr-naight: “Laa eddyrashoonagh ayns y thie-lheeys: hoght ashoonyn, un possan.” Ta jalloo jeh Lola as jeh ny bratteeyn ayn.

Ta Lola cur y pabyr-naight da'n voir eck ayns y çheer eck. Ta'n voir eck maynrey son y naight vie.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Lola veih çheer joarree?
Ta. Haink ee dys Ellan Vannin shiaght bleeaney er dy henney.
Ren Lola çheet er y traen as er y lhong?
Ren. Hie ee er y traen dys Lerphoyll, as haink ee er y lhong dys Doolish.
Quoid dy ashoonyn t'ayns y possan eck?
Ta hoght ashoonyn ayns y possan eck.
Row brattagh son dagh ashoon ec y dorrys?
Va. Va hoght bratteeyn ayn.
Row'n naight ayns y phabyr-naight?
Va. Va'n naight as jalloo ayns y phabyr-naight.

lessons.title: Billioonyn dy chillagyn
lessons.summary: Teacher Matthew tells his class that the body has billions of cells, that carbon is in every living creature, and that some creatures are poisonous; then each child designs a picture of the body.
lessons.text:
Ta Matthew Clarke ny ynseyder ayns bunscoill ayns Doolish. Jiu, ta dean beg echey: t'eh shirrey dy ynsaghey da ny paitçhyn mychione y corp. She shen y dean echey son y laa.

“Ta'n corp jeant jeh killagyn,” t'eh gra. “Ta billioonyn dy chillagyn ayns dagh corp. Ta mysh 86 billioon killag 'sy chione hene!”

“Billioon!” ta Scarlett gra. Ta Scarlett 10 bleeaney d'eash. “Shen earroo feer vooar.”

“Ta,” ta Matthew gra. “As ta carboan ayns dagh killag. Ta carboan ayns dagh cretoor bio: ayns deiney, ayns moddee, ayns ushagyn, ayns biljyn. Ta sleih oaylleeagh shirrey bea er seihllyn elley, as t'ad shirrey carboan.”

“Vel strughtoor ec y chorp?” ta Scarlett gra.

“Ta,” ta Matthew gra. “Ta strughtoor lajer ec y chorp, myr strughtoor thie. Ta strughtoor elley ec dagh cretoor. Ta strughtoor ec eeast nagh vel ec ushag.”

“Vel cretooryn nieunagh ayn?” ta guilley gra.

“Ta. Ta cretooryn nieunagh ayns ymmodee çheeraghyn. Agh cha nel ram cretooryn nieunagh ayns Ellan Vannin.”

Lurg shen, ta Matthew gra: “Nish, jean-jee kiadd. Ta dagh paitçhey kiaddey jalloo mooar jeh'n chorp.”

Ta Scarlett kiaddey jalloo. Ta'n kiadd eck aitt: ta'n corp jeant jeh ram killagyn beggey, as ta carboan screeuit ayns dagh killag.

“Kiadd mie!” ta Matthew gra. Ta'n dean echey jeant.

Feyshtyn:
Row dean ec Matthew son y laa?
Va. V'eh shirrey dy ynsaghey da ny paitçhyn mychione y corp.
Vel billioonyn dy chillagyn ayns y corp?
Ta. Ta mysh 86 billioon killag 'sy chione hene.
Vel carboan ayns dagh cretoor bio?
Ta. Ta carboan ayns dagh killag.
Vel strughtoor lajer ec y chorp?
Ta. Ta strughtoor lajer ec y chorp, myr strughtoor thie.
Ren Scarlett kiaddey jalloo?
Ren. Va'n kiadd eck aitt.

lessons.title: Cair dagh peiagh
lessons.summary: Alice leads a small women's health foundation; she asks the government's official committee for money for a clinic, and the clinic opens the following year.
lessons.text:
Ta Alice Sansbury 60 bleeaney d'eash. She toshiagh ee ec undinys beg ayns Doolish. Ta'n undinys gobbraghey son slaynt mraane.

Ta bunraght ec yn undinys. Ayns y vunraght, ta screeuit: “Ta cair ec dagh peiagh er lheeys vie. Cha nel keintys peiagh scanshoil: ta'n cair cheddin ec mraane as ec deiney.” Ta Alice credjal dy vel y cair shoh feer scanshoil.

Agh cha nel thie-lheeys ec yn undinys, as ta feme oc er argid.

Jiu, ta Alice goll dys corpane slattyssagh jeh'n ghurneilys. She'n corpane shoh ta reaghey argid son thieyn-lheeys. Peter yn toshiagh er y chorpane.

“Ta cair ec mraane er lheeys vie,” ta Alice gra rish y chorpane. “Ta'n cair shen ayns bunraght yn undinys ain. Agh ta feme ain er thie-lheeys beg son mraane ayns Doolish.”

Ta'n corpane slattyssagh loayrt mychione rish tammylt. Eisht, ta Peter gra: “Ta'n gurneilys goaill rish. Ver shin argid da'n undinys 'sy vlein eiyrtyssagh.”

Ta Alice maynrey. T'ee goll er ash dys yn undinys, as t'ee gra yn naight vie rish ny mraane elley.

'Sy vlein eiyrtyssagh, ta'n thie-lheeys beg foshlit. Ta Alice as Peter ec y dorrys. “Nish, cha nel y cair ayns y vunraght ynrican,” ta Alice gra. “T'ee ayns y thie-lheeys neesht.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel Alice ny toshiagh ec undinys?
Ta. She toshiagh ee ec undinys beg ayns Doolish.
Vel cair ec dagh peiagh er lheeys vie?
Ta. Ta shen screeuit ayns y vunraght.
Vel keintys peiagh scanshoil?
Cha nel. Ta'n cair cheddin ec mraane as ec deiney.
Ren y gurneilys goaill rish?
Ren. Dooyrt Peter dy beagh argid ec yn undinys 'sy vlein eiyrtyssagh.
Row'n thie-lheeys foshlit 'sy vlein eiyrtyssagh?
Va. Va'n thie-lheeys beg foshlit.

lessons.title: Skeealaght ayns Mee Houney
lessons.summary: In November Jake, ill at home, reads a novel about a fairy; his grandmother Ruby shows him an old album and map and tells him the island's tradition about a fairy in an old temple who cured sick children.
lessons.text:
Ta Mee Houney ayn. Ta'n emshir fliugh as dorraghey. Ta Jake Maddrell 10 bleeaney d'eash. Ta çhingys beg er, as t'eh 'sy thie marish e shenn-voir, Ruby.

Ta Jake lhaih noaskeeal. Ta'n noaskeeal mychione shee ta cummal ayns çhiamble shenn er cronk.

“Vel shee ayn dy firrinagh?” t'eh gra.

“Cha nel fys aym,” ta Ruby gra. “Agh ta skeealaght mychione ny shee ayns tradishoon Vannin. Va my voir gra skeealyn dou ayns Mee Houney, tra va çhingys orrym.”

Ta Ruby goaill albym shenn. Ayns yn albym, ta jallooyn jeh'n voir eck. Ayns un jalloo, ta'n voir eck shassoo ec boalley shenn er cronk.

“Ta'n boalley shen veih çhiamble feer shenn,” ta Ruby gra. “Ayns y skeealaght shenn, va shee cummal ayns y çhiamble. Tra va çhingys er paitçhey, va'n shee cur lus da. Lurg y lus, va'n paitçhey mie reesht.”

Ta kaart ayns yn albym neesht. Ta Ruby soilshaghey yn kaart da Jake. “Jeeagh: shoh'n cronk, as shoh'n boalley. Va tradishoon ayn: va sleih goll dys y boalley ayns Mee Houney, as va ad faagail bee son y shee.”

“Vod mee goll dys y boalley?” ta Jake gra.

“My vees oo mie reesht, hed shin dys y chronk lesh y chaart,” ta Ruby gra.

Ta Jake goll er ash dys y noaskeeal echey. T'eh credjal dy vel y shee ayns y çhiamble foast.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Mee Houney ayn?
Ta. Ta'n emshir fliugh as dorraghey.
Vel Jake lhaih noaskeeal?
Ta. Ta'n noaskeeal mychione shee ayns çhiamble shenn.
Vel skeealaght mychione ny shee ayns tradishoon Vannin?
Ta. Va moir Ruby gra skeealyn j'ee ayns Mee Houney.
Row moir Ruby ec boalley shenn?
Va. Va'n boalley veih çhiamble feer shenn.
Vel kaart ayns yn albym?
Ta. Ta kaart jeh'n chronk ayns yn albym.
